title: 2020 Residential Energy Consumption Survey public microdata landing page and reuse policy
version: 2020 final release, January 2024 update; pages retrieved 2026-08-11

doi.absence_reason: EIA does not assign a DOI on the registered 2020 RECS microdata page.

license.name: United States government work; EIA content generally public domain

units.intended_energy_estimates: units declared by each RECS microdata variable

measurement_uncertainty.description: Microdata and replicate-weight files are not registered, so sampling uncertainty cannot yet be calculated.

known_gaps: The household microdata and replicate weights were not downloaded or frozen.
RECS supports appliance presence, dwelling, and energy-use distributions but not minute-level natural action timing.
The survey represents U.S. occupied primary residences and needs explicit transferability limits for European scenarios.

preprocessing.description: Checksum the official microdata landing page and reuse policy without ingesting survey values.

permitted_use.purpose: Plan weighted priors for household composition, equipment presence, lighting, heating, and energy-use distributions.
permitted_use.notes: Do not infer action timing from cross-sectional equipment or annual-energy variables.
